page.overview:
Who is Ahl?

Ahl, the God of Superheroes is a primeval entity originating from Final Heaven. In time primordial, he descended to Earth, landing at the site of what would one day become Mount Justice.

Upon arrival (and after - with the aid of the JLA—helping rout an attempt by Chronos to prevent his mission), he infused the planet with the idea he embodied—the concept of the superhero.

He would come to oversee the transdimensional corporation Retconn—who were in fact his creators, building him from old comics in a process which he, travelling through time to create the superhero concept, would turn into a stable time loop—until one day being murdered with "the brick that can think" by Haxxalon the Star Archer.
